definitions.explanation: An object that has been stolen, viewed especially from a legal or law-enforcement perspective. Knowingly buying, selling, or possessing such items is itself a crime.

examples.japanese: {盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}っていた→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is suspected of selling stolen goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押収|おうしゅう}→押収：19033_oushuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police confiscated a large quantity of stolen goods from the warehouse.

notes:
Compound of {盗|とう} (steal) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods, item). A formal/legal term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell stolen goods
- {盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy stolen goods
- {盗品|とうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押収|おうしゅう}→押収：19033_oushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confiscate stolen goods
- {盗品|とうひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧: knowing it is stolen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {贓物|ぞうぶつ}: stolen property — archaic legal term, rarely used today
- {盗難品|とうなんひん}: item lost to theft — emphasizes the victim's perspective
